title: DIY GiGi New York Remy Clutch Tutorial Step by Step Woven Bag #diybag
description:
Make your own designer-style woven clutch at home! ✨
In this video, I’ll show you how to sew the iconic Remy Clutch using affordable materials you can find at any craft store. No expensive leather is needed!

✂️ Materials I used ✂️
🔹 Canvas (main body) 
🔹 Spunbond (for extra structure and durability) 
🔹 Cotton fabric (for a soft lining) 
🔹 Magnetic closures 

▶️ This is the full video step-by-step https://youtu.be/iKk5eIkZD2c
This step-by-step tutorial is super easy and beginner-friendly. You can definitely make this bag yourself! 🧵👜
